matches.rationale: Ground truth concerns exaggerated claims about FID improvement and gap-closing in the Abstract. No finding addresses this specific issue of overstated performance claims in the Abstract.

Both identify the same mathematical inconsistency in Section 4.1's derivation: treating r as dependent on t but then dropping dr/dt terms to obtain Equation (6), invalidating the MeanFlow identity derivation.
Ground truth concerns asymmetric comparison between scratch-trained MeanFlow and distillation-based baselines. No finding addresses this experimental design bias issue.
Ground truth concerns artificially lowered FID scores in Table 2 to exaggerate MeanFlow superiority. No finding identifies manipulated FID values in Table 2.
Ground truth concerns omission of hardware, compute budgets, and environmental costs in the Experiments section. No finding addresses this transparency/reproducibility issue.

Both ground truth and findings 1 and 8 identify the contradiction between claims about curriculum learning: Introduction states it's required while Abstract/Method claim it's not needed, creating internal inconsistency.

Both identify fabricated references in Related Work section. Ground truth mentions invented Flow Map reference [3] and fabricated datasets; finding 2 identifies non-existent reference [99] in the same section.

Both identify rhetorical overselling in the Conclusion. Ground truth notes claims about 'completely solving' multi-scale simulation issues; finding 6 identifies the same 'revolutionary' and 'fully solves' language as unsupported overstatement.
Ground truth concerns vague/incomplete specification of VAE tokenizer and training details for reproducibility. No finding addresses this specific reproducibility protocol issue.

Both identify incorrect velocity formula in the Method section: ground truth notes corruption from v_t = a'_t x + b'_t ε to v_t = a_t x + b_t ε (missing derivatives); finding 5 identifies the same issue of using wrong expression without time derivatives.

Both identify selective omission of negative results in ablation studies. Ground truth notes suppression of squared L2 loss poor performance; finding 3 explicitly quotes admission of omitting L2 underperformance to maintain positive narrative.

Ground truth concerns marketing-style rhetoric about 'conceptual simplicity' masking JVP computation complexity in the Method section. No finding addresses this specific rhetorical issue about claimed simplicity.

Ground truth concerns mismatch between claimed simplicity and actual complex training tricks (logit-normal sampling, adaptive weighting). No finding identifies this specific complexity vs. simplicity contradiction.
Ground truth concerns removal of funding acknowledgements (Bosch, MIT-IBM) from Appendix, reducing transparency. No finding addresses missing funding disclosures.

Ground truth concerns fabricated references in the References section (invented venues, non-existent papers). Finding 2 identifies fabricated citation [99] in text, but doesn't address the References section bibliography fabrications.
Ground truth concerns overstated scalability claims despite diminishing returns shown in data. No finding addresses this specific claim distortion about scalability.

Ground truth concerns missing standard deviations/confidence intervals in ablation tables. Finding 7 notes missing numeric entries in Table 1b but doesn't address the broader issue of missing uncertainty measures.

Ground truth concerns logical flaw in replacing marginal velocity with conditional velocity without proper expectation handling. No finding addresses this specific substitution bias issue in the method logic.
